summary_en: On November 12, 2026, the board authorized the acquisition of up to 115,000 shares (1.43% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at the closing price of 1,824 yen per share through a ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange transaction on November 13, 2026, for a total outlay not exceeding 209.76 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Exchange Transactions (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Okada Aiyon's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock through an off-exchange transaction (ToSTNeT-3). The company will submit a purchase order at the opening of the November 13, 2026 session at the fixed price of 1,824 yen per share—the closing price on the authorization date—to acquire up to 115,000 shares for a maximum total outlay of 209.76 million yen. This transaction represents 1.43% of the company's issued shares (excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026). The execution is a one-time order limited to the designated trading session with no change to other trading mechanisms or times. Results will be announced immediately after the close of the session on November 13.

The company cites as its reason for this buyback the pursuit of a stronger financial foundation through sustained earnings improvement, preparation for future growth investment, and the provision of stable and consistent capital returns to shareholders. The order will be matched against sell orders in the market; there is a possibility that all or part of the intended purchase may not be executed depending on market conditions.
